name: Burleson Town Center
demographics: Burleson Town Center serves a growing suburban family demographic in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, with primary visitors consisting of middle-income households with children. The trade area draws from Burleson's expanding residential communities, attracting shoppers aged 25-54 who prioritize convenience and value-oriented retail options. The center caters to everyday shopping needs with a mix of service-oriented tenants, appealing to working families seeking accessible neighborhood retail close to home.
description: Burleson Town Center is a community-focused shopping destination located at 811 Northeast Alsbury Boulevard in Burleson, Texas, serving the southern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Managed by JAH Realty, a full-service real estate company specializing in investments, development, leasing, management, and construction across the Dallas-Fort Worth and Oklahoma City markets, the center reflects their commitment to enhancing property value through strategic tenant selection and professional management. JAH Realty's leasing team works diligently to maintain strong occupancy by partnering with qualified tenants who complement the center's retail mix and serve the local community's needs. The center operates with extended hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, providing convenient access for shoppers throughout the day. With a strong 4.3-star rating from over 2,200 reviews, Burleson Town Center has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination that combines accessibility, variety, and community-oriented service for residents of this growing Texas suburb.
summary: Burleson Town Center is a community shopping destination in the southern Dallas-Fort Worth area, professionally managed by JAH Realty. With extended operating hours and a strong customer rating, the center serves the everyday retail needs of Burleson's growing suburban population.
